items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: B. comes by the house and rings, knocks on the door and asks my brother... 'I want to talk, is Joe there?'

ctx.x: B. Walker. His name is William B. Walker. We called him B., you know. Well, my brother had arranged for a lot of the guys to stop by I hadn't seen in a long time but B. comes by the house and rings, knocks on the door and asks my brother, Rob says, "I want to talk, is Joe there?" He said, "Yeah, Joe's there." He said, "Well, there's a lady out there that wants to see him."
Just a second. So this guy says, "Is Joe there?"
